mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.25% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 7% for two consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in GDPC1 signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2%) in at least 50% of quarters with GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO above 0.5% for three consecutive months signals accelerating industrial production, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL above 0.3 percentage points in the same month signals a tightening accompanied by falling inflation, which historically supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND CPIAUCSL decreases by >0.3pp in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST above 1% signals strengthening housing demand, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.3%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 0.4% and UNRATE above 8% in the same month signals strong labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.4% AND UNRATE > 8% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in RSAFS below $300 million signals reduced household savings, which typically precedes increased consumption and higher corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +2%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
